summary: Adds a three-mode generated-announcement renderer above shared logical-voice TTS, with collision-safe scratch files, atomic publication, conservative filesystem/Track rollback, explicit Speech Splice cue policy, and analysis-owned Rotation Asset cues. Dedication intros now use Speech Splice while retaining their text, metadata, scheduling, locking, CAS attachment, and warning behavior. No migration, dependency, systemd-unit, or production change.
